name: hamster-ledger
description: 仓鼠记账：本地优先的账单导入、跨平台去重与收支汇总

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @hamster-ledger/web --
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @hamster-ledger/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @hamster-ledger/core && npm run build --workspace @hamster-ledger/importers && npm run build --workspace @hamster-ledger/fixtures && npm run build --workspace @hamster-ledger/ledger-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @hamster-ledger/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @hamster-ledger/mobile && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run tokens:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:boundaries && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:sites && npm run test:server
scripts.android:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run start --workspace @hamster-ledger/mobile
scripts.android:run: npm run build:packages && npm run android --workspace @hamster-ledger/mobile
scripts.android:export: npm run build:packages && npm run export --workspace @hamster-ledger/mobile
